_comment: Canonical Essential Graphics 'Expose' control names this extension looks for on a .mogrt, mirrors src/presets/mogrtContract.js CANONICAL_PARAMS. A preset's mogrt.paramMap can override any of these per-template.

emphasisText.notes: Optional second text layer listing the emphasis word(s), if your template overlays them separately instead of recoloring inline.

fontWeight.notes: 100-900. Only useful if your text layer's font family has weight variants wired to a Responsive Design - Type font selector, or if you rig a font-family swap via expression.

fillOpacity.notes: 0-100. Also used as the fallback fade in/out target if 'Animation Style' isn't implemented.

tracking.notes: Maps to the text layer's Character panel Tracking value.

shadowEnabled.notes: Toggle the layer's Drop Shadow style opacity between 0 and its authored value.

blurAmount.notes: Wire to a Gaussian/Fast Box Blur effect's Blurriness.

animationStyleIndex.notes: 0=none 1=fade 2=pop 3=slide-up 4=slide-down 5=typewriter. Drives which pre-built animation rig plays via expression selection. If omitted, the extension falls back to a plain opacity fade using fillOpacity.
